listing.name: Cardinal Mode
listing.summary: A very lightweight mod that simply exposes the setting "CardinalMode", which, when set to true, enables you to move your ship according to absolute direction rather than relative facing.
listing.aiSummary: Enables moving the ship according to absolute direction rather than relative facing by exposing a hidden setting.

description: Exposes the undocumented CardinalMode setting. When enabled, ship movement follows absolute directions instead of the ship's current facing. Note that this overrides turn keys, requiring shift-aiming for rotation.
